snippet.title: Journey Into the Emerald Dream | Expansion Announcement | Hearthstone
snippet.description:
Step Into the Emerald Dream, where ancient magic, new mechanics, and Wild Gods await. Join the developers for an inside look.

The Emerald Dream is a realm of ethereal entities and the source of all Nature magic on Azeroth. But Ysera’s domain is under attack from a creeping corruption, threatening to turn the Dream into a Nightmare! Will you Imbue your Hero Power with blessings from the World Tree or accept the Dark Gifts of the Old Gods? Choose One and rally massive Wild Gods to your cause. The portal is opening; prepare to step Into the Emerald Dream! 

Into the Emerald Dream launches on March 25 with 145 new cards! You can find the Into the Emerald Dream reveal schedule, and all cards already revealed, in the official Card Library. Check back often to see everything we’re dreaming up! 

Plus, get ready for the returning Pre-Release Tavern Brawl from March 18-25! Open and play with your pre-purchased cards, and snag even more packs along the way. Keep an eye out for more details as reveal season winds down—you won’t want to miss this!

Pre-Purchase the Into the Emerald Dream Mega Bundle: https://shop.battle.net/product/hearthstone-into-the-emerald-dream-mega-bundle
Learn more about Into the Emerald Dream: https://blizz.ly/4jOQ7lQ
Read the full 31.6 Patch Notes: https://blizz.ly/4gzOZQk
Into the Emerald Dream Card Library: https://hearthstone.blizzard.com/cards

https://hearthstone.blizzard.com
